name: Evil-Merodach
bio: Evil-Merodach, king of Babylon, released Jehoiachin, the former king of Judah, from prison in the thirty-seventh year of his captivity, in the first year of his own reign. He spoke kindly to Jehoiachin, gave him a seat of honor above the other captive kings in Babylon, provided him new clothes in place of his prison garments, and gave him a regular daily allowance for the rest of his life (2 Kings 25:27-30).
